/* The <dialog> element itself. UA defaults give us white background,
   solid border, 1em padding, and absolute centering — we strip those
   so the dialog renders as a transparent container with the card
   doing all the visual work. No z-index needed: showModal() puts the
   dialog in the browser's top-layer, which sits above ALL stacking
   contexts regardless of z-index (so we can ignore Paddle's MOR
   footer at z-index 2147483000 and Stripe iframes entirely). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay {
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  /* 270px matches iOS UIAlertController width exactly. Width
     responsiveness comes via 'width: calc(100% - 40px)' so we keep
     20px breathing room on narrow viewports. */
  max-width: 270px;
  width: calc(100% - 40px);
  max-height: calc(100% - 40px);
  /* UA inset/margin auto centers the dialog. Explicit override of
     padding (0) so the card fills the dialog box edge-to-edge. */
  margin: auto;
  overflow: visible;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card-in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
/* The ::backdrop pseudo-element is the dimmed area BEHIND the
   top-layer dialog. Only exists after showModal() — for show() or
   <dialog open>, ::backdrop is invisible. Subtle dim matching iOS
   UIAlertController (the card's vibrancy does the heavy lifting). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay::backdrop {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in 160ms ease-out;
}
@keyframes helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card {
  /* iOS UIAlertController vibrancy: translucent surface + heavy
     backdrop-filter blur. The card itself has saturation/contrast
     boost so light-mode content from behind doesn't bleed grey. */
  background: rgba(242, 242, 247, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}
@keyframes helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__title {
  /* iOS alert title spec: 17px, semibold, centered. */
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #000000;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 19px 16px 17px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-align: center;
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__actions {
  /* Two side-by-side buttons separated by a vertical hairline,
     with a horizontal hairline above them. Matches iOS
     UIAlertController two-action button row. */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  border-top: 0.5px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.29);
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action {
  /* Buttons are translucent text-only — NO filled rectangle.
     iOS system blue text, no background, no shadow. */
  flex: 1 1 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #007aff;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-family: inherit;
  /* iOS standard touch-target height. */
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 11px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: background-color 120ms ease-out;
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action:hover {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
}
/* The destructive/cancel button is regular weight; the default
   action (Open) is semibold. iOS UIAlertController convention. */
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action--cancel {
  font-weight: 400;
  /* Vertical hairline between the two actions. */
  border-right: 0.5px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.29);
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action--open {
  font-weight: 600;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card {
    /* iOS dark UIAlertController surface (translucent gray). */
    background: rgba(44, 44, 46, 0.78);
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__title {
    color: #ffffff;
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__actions {
    border-top-color: rgba(84, 84, 88, 0.65);
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action {
    /* iOS system blue dark variant — slightly brighter. */
    color: #0a84ff;
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action--cancel {
    border-right-color: rgba(84, 84, 88, 0.65);
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  }
  .helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action:active {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  }
}

/* The <dialog> element itself. UA defaults give us white background,
   solid border, 1em padding, and absolute centering — we strip those
   so the dialog renders as a transparent container with the card
   doing all the visual work. No z-index needed: showModal() puts the
   dialog in the browser's top-layer, which sits above ALL stacking
   contexts regardless of z-index (so we can ignore Paddle's MOR
   footer at z-index 2147483000 and Stripe iframes entirely). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay {
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  /* 270px matches iOS UIAlertController width exactly. Width
     responsiveness comes via 'width: calc(100% - 40px)' so we keep
     20px breathing room on narrow viewports. */
  max-width: 270px;
  width: calc(100% - 40px);
  max-height: calc(100% - 40px);
  /* UA inset/margin auto centers the dialog. Explicit override of
     padding (0) so the card fills the dialog box edge-to-edge. */
  margin: auto;
  overflow: visible;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card-in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
/* The ::backdrop pseudo-element is the dimmed area BEHIND the
   top-layer dialog. Only exists after showModal() — for show() or
   <dialog open>, ::backdrop is invisible. Subtle dim matching iOS
   UIAlertController (the card's vibrancy does the heavy lifting). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay::backdrop {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in 160ms ease-out;
}
@keyframes helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card {
  /* iOS UIAlertController vibrancy: translucent surface + heavy
     backdrop-filter blur. The card itself has saturation/contrast
     boost so light-mode content from behind doesn't bleed grey. */
  background: rgba(242, 242, 247, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}
@keyframes helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card-in {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.94); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__title {
  /* iOS alert title spec: 17px, semibold, centered. */
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #000000;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 19px 16px 17px;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  text-align: center;
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__actions {
  /* Two side-by-side buttons separated by a vertical hairline,
     with a horizontal hairline above them. Matches iOS
     UIAlertController two-action button row. */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  border-top: 0.5px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.29);
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action {
  /* Buttons are translucent text-only — NO filled rectangle.
     iOS system blue text, no background, no shadow. */
  flex: 1 1 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: #007aff;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-family: inherit;
  /* iOS standard touch-target height. */
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 11px 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  text-decoration: none !important;

/* The <dialog> element itself. UA defaults give us white background,
   solid border, 1em padding, and absolute centering — we strip those
   so the dialog renders as a transparent container with the card
   doing all the visual work. No z-index needed: showModal() puts the
   dialog in the browser's top-layer, which sits above ALL stacking
   contexts regardless of z-index (so we can ignore Paddle's MOR
   footer at z-index 2147483000 and Stripe iframes entirely). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay {
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  background: transparent;
  /* 270px matches iOS UIAlertController width exactly. Width
     responsiveness comes via 'width: calc(100% - 40px)' so we keep
     20px breathing room on narrow viewports. */
  max-width: 270px;
  width: calc(100% - 40px);
  max-height: calc(100% - 40px);
  /* UA inset/margin auto centers the dialog. Explicit override of
     padding (0) so the card fills the dialog box edge-to-edge. */
  margin: auto;
  overflow: visible;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card-in 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
/* The ::backdrop pseudo-element is the dimmed area BEHIND the
   top-layer dialog. Only exists after showModal() — for show() or
   <dialog open>, ::backdrop is invisible. Subtle dim matching iOS
   UIAlertController (the card's vibrancy does the heavy lifting). */
dialog.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-overlay::backdrop {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  animation: helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in 160ms ease-out;
}
@keyframes helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-fade-in {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card {
  /* iOS UIAlertController vibrancy: translucent surface + heavy
     backdrop-filter blur. The card itself has saturation/contrast
     boost so light-mode content from behind doesn't bleed grey. */
  background: rgba(242, 242, 247, 0.78);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(40px);
  border-radius: 14px;

  /* iOS alert title spec: 17px, semibold, centered. */
  font-size: 17px;

  line-height: 1.3;

  flex-direction: row;
  border-top: 0.5px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.29);
}

  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
}
.helium-paddle-redirect-fallback-card__action:active {
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);

  }
}
